title: HealthConnect Clinic Experience Lab
overview: I analyzed 5,000 clinic appointment records from January 2025 to June 2026 to identify patterns associated with patient no-shows and support operational decision-making
businessProblem: The clinic faced a high rate of missed appointments, resulting in potential inefficiencies in scheduling, underutilised healthcare resources and reduced appointment availability. The project aimed to analyse appointment patterns and identify factors associated with patient no-shows, including booking lead time, previous attendance history, appointment type and reminder status. The goal was to generate data-driven insights that could support improved appointment management, patient attendance and operational efficiency.
methodology:
I tested the dashboard and analysis across different segments to validate the findings:
Reminder Status × Appointment Type
Appointment Type × Previous No-Show History
Previous No-Show History × Booking Lead Time
This helped me identify where interpretations needed refinement and where findings remained consistent.
keyFindings:
Identified the most frequently recorded medical conditions and test-result patterns.
Revealed differences in hospital activity and billing across the dataset.
Enabled individual patient records to be explored alongside broader population patterns.
Connected patient, operational, and financial information in one dashboard.
outcome: Good analytics isn't just about finding patterns. It's about testing them, questioning them, and communicating them responsibly.
